summary: Excel now gives a new PC its own access to the ArcRho Server the first time it opens, with nobody setting the PC up by hand.
details: The first time the add-in loads on a PC with no ArcRho access, it sets that PC up for the person logged in and says so in the loading window while it does; formulas then work straight away.
A PC that already has access, including one where access was deliberately turned off, is left exactly as it is.
A PC away from the office tries once when Excel opens and then carries on, so it never pauses again during that session.
